hooks.name: Crew app guard
hooks.description: After a manifest, agent, skill, UI or backend file is saved, rebuild the UI bundle and re-run the Kiro Crew manifest rules, the bundle-externals check, the trademark scan and the license policy.

action.command: pnpm -C tooling run build:ui && pnpm -C tooling run check

hooks.name: License and trademark gate before the turn ends
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, re-run the dependency license audit and the digest-based trademark scan over every file a commit could contain.

action.command: pnpm -C tooling run licenses && pnpm -C tooling run trademarks
